name: Rice Krispies
siboNotes: Rice-based cereals are generally well-tolerated for SIBO as rice is easily digestible and low in fermentable carbohydrates.
preparationTips: Serve with lactose-free milk or suitable plant milk
Check ingredient labels for added high-FODMAP ingredients like inulin or honey
Portion control is important - stick to recommended serving size
Can be eaten dry as a snack or used in baking recipes
nutritionalHighlights: Fortified with B vitamins and iron
